question: Should an empty QA Lab dashboard launch intentionally switch from the prior live flow-oriented behavior to the new smoke-profile request defaults?
rationale: Both behaviors are plausible QA operator contracts, but the diff changes the implicit behavior for existing dashboard and endpoint callers; code review cannot determine which operational default maintainers want to preserve.

options.title: Accept smoke-profile default
options.body: Treat the smoke profile as the intentional safe default for empty dashboard requests and document the resulting operator contract.

options.title: Preserve legacy empty launch
options.body: Keep the prior live flow-oriented empty-request behavior and require operators to select the smoke profile explicitly.

recommendation.title: Preserve legacy empty launch
recommendation.body: Keep the prior live flow-oriented empty-request behavior and require operators to select the smoke profile explicitly.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly connected to the reported QA Lab behavior and the proposed planner contract.
